svg.title: Where a formatting requirement is enforced
svg.desc: Prompt-only formatting asks for a shape and checks the result afterward. Constrained generation also masks unsupported continuations. Both paths need completion checks, parsing, and policy validation; prompts can guide either path.

text.font-family: Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Prompt guidance can accompany either path; this is not an accuracy ranking.
